claude-code.name: Claude Code

verification.note: In daily production use by the maintainer, but no formal probe run has been recorded. Per XSPEC-357 AC-3.3 a verification claim without evidence is not a verification. Also cannot be self-judged (§3.3).

agentReads.reason: Not entered. A P7 run is on record (integrations/verification/claude-code/2026-08-22.md: 3 of 3 index-arm runs followed the scheme, judged blind by Codex). XSPEC-357 R8 AC-8.2 records this cell as not verified while P7 is unimplemented; whether this one-off run counts as P7 being implemented is undecided, so it has not been entered as this cell's result.

followsInTask.reason: Not run. The tool is installed on the machine that verifies; XSPEC-357 R5 sets the order of the runs.

violationDetected.reason: Partly covered, and not entered as passed. Tested (see partialEvidence): `uds check --ci`, which the native pre-commit hook runs, exits 1 and names the file when an installed standard is edited or the UDS block is deleted from a tool's rules file; `uds simulate -s commit-message` fails a malformed message when someone runs it; with `uds init --with-hooks` the Claude Code hook refuses a malformed commit message. Not covered: for the other tools nothing checks a commit message at commit time by default, and `uds init` installs no git commit-msg hook, so the example XSPEC-357 R8 AC-8.4 gives, a malformed commit message, is not caught automatically. Whether the installed-standards integrity check alone should count as this cell is undecided.

claude-code.instructionFileNote: Deliberately absent. Every other agent's instructionFile names a repo template that IS what the adopter receives (or the fallback copied when generation fails). Claude Code's CLAUDE.md is generated by writeIntegrationFile and appears in no copy map, so integrations/claude-code/CLAUDE.md is written by no code path and the repo-root CLAUDE.md is UDS's own developer doc. Template-level tier checks on either measure something no adopter has. The generated file is checked instead by scripts/check-adopter-instruction-files.ts (XSPEC-357 R7). Decided 2026-09-08.
